description: This file provides utility functions for parsing command-line arguments related to Vitest reports, loading a Vitest JSON report based on given arguments, and formatting milliseconds. It imports utility modules for argument parsing and JSON handling.

methods.name: parseVitestReportArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to extract Vitest report configuration options such as config file, report limit, and report path.

methods.name: loadVitestReportFromArgs
methods.description: Loads a Vitest JSON report file based on parsed arguments and a given prefix, returning the parsed JSON data.

methods.name: formatMs
methods.description: Formats a numeric value into milliseconds string with specified decimal digits.
